phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F2 Phase C1 — F21 Currency Coverage Audit
meaning: Currency (notes and coins) only; component of F2 currency and deposits
purpose: Test exact ECB QSA who-to-whom coverage for F21 before any currency allocation or total-F2 promotion.

official_definition.rule: F21 currency is notes and coins issued or authorised by monetary authorities; resident holdings may include domestic currency and foreign currency issued by non-resident monetary authorities.
official_definition.implication_for_rmd: Issuer concentration is an empirical/structural hypothesis to audit, not a licence to assign all F21 liabilities to BNR or to allocate holder sectors synthetically.

canonical_orientation.domestic_holder_to_domestic_issuer: Probe both QSA W2 mirrors independently: holder-asset (reference sector = holder, counterpart sector = issuer, entry A) and issuer-liability (reference sector = issuer, counterpart sector = holder, entry L). Prefer neither by assumption; if both are published they must reconcile within tolerance.
canonical_orientation.rest_of_world_holder_to_resident_issuer: QSA W1 issuer-liability series with counterpart sector S1
canonical_orientation.resident_holder_to_rest_of_world_issuer: QSA W1 holder-asset series with counterpart sector S1

promotion_rule: This phase may only classify F21 source coverage, source orientation and reconciliation. A domestic cell may be considered covered when an exact W2 asset-side or liability-side representation is available; if both are available they must agree within tolerance. Materialization requires a later gate with immutable source vintage, deterministic offline regeneration, and exact observed/derived values for every promoted cell.
failure_rule: If QSA does not identify the bilateral holder distribution or exact complements are not uniquely determined and independently controlled, F21 remains unresolved. Currency-in-circulation aggregates may be controls but must not be allocated across sectors by shares or convenience residuals.
system_dynamics_conformity: Accounting-only audit. No behavioural mechanism, feedback loop, delay, reference mode or behavioural-closure status may change.
